titleEn: Minimum Swaps To Make Sequences Increasing
title: 使序列递增的最小交换次数
summary: 两个等长数组每个位置可交换两数组元素，求使两序列都严格递增的最少交换次数。
insight: 每个位置只需记录当前不交换 keep 与交换 swap 的最小代价；根据与前一位置同向或交叉的严格递增关系转移。
pitfalls: 交换操作只能发生在相同下标
交叉递增支持 swap→keep、keep→swap，两类条件可同时成立

solutions.title: 每个位置交换或保留的双状态 DP
solutions.idea: 滚动维护截至当前位置两种决策的最小交换数。
steps: 若 nums1[i]>nums1[i-1] 且 nums2 同样递增，更新 nextKeep=keep、nextSwap=swap+1
若交叉比较也递增，更新 nextKeep=min(nextKeep,swap)、nextSwap=min(nextSwap,keep+1)；滚动并返回 min

code.java: class Solution { public int minSwap(int[] nums1,int[] nums2){int keep=0,swap=1,infinity=1000000;for(int i=1;i<nums1.length;i++){int nextKeep=infinity,nextSwap=infinity;if(nums1[i]>nums1[i-1]&&nums2[i]>nums2[i-1]){nextKeep=keep;nextSwap=swap+1;}if(nums1[i]>nums2[i-1]&&nums2[i]>nums1[i-1]){nextKeep=Math.min(nextKeep,swap);nextSwap=Math.min(nextSwap,keep+1);}keep=nextKeep;swap=nextSwap;}return Math.min(keep,swap);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSwap(nums1:IntArray,nums2:IntArray):Int{var keep=0;var swap=1;val infinity=1000000;for(i in 1 until nums1.size){var nextKeep=infinity;var nextSwap=infinity;if(nums1[i]>nums1[i-1]&&nums2[i]>nums2[i-1]){nextKeep=keep;nextSwap=swap+1};if(nums1[i]>nums2[i-1]&&nums2[i]>nums1[i-1]){nextKeep=minOf(nextKeep,swap);nextSwap=minOf(nextSwap,keep+1)};keep=nextKeep;swap=nextSwap};return minOf(keep,swap)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minSwap(vector<int>& nums1,vector<int>& nums2){int keep=0,swapped=1,infinity=1000000;for(int i=1;i<(int)nums1.size();++i){int nextKeep=infinity,nextSwap=infinity;if(nums1[i]>nums1[i-1]&&nums2[i]>nums2[i-1]){nextKeep=keep;nextSwap=swapped+1;}if(nums1[i]>nums2[i-1]&&nums2[i]>nums1[i-1]){nextKeep=min(nextKeep,swapped);nextSwap=min(nextSwap,keep+1);}keep=nextKeep;swapped=nextSwap;}return min(keep,swapped);} };
